=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_issue_route.py: lines 213-217 in security_dependency_number() | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: An ordinary issue containing a “Depends on:” line can be treated as an unverified security dependency and held indefinitely.
  WHY: The parser raises for matching prose without security markers, and callers turn that into a held verdict; openai_gpt-6-luna rated this MAJOR while the other reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml: lines 499, 507 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The step’s shell script embeds the raw `${{ github.repository }}` expression, which fails when contract tests execute the script directly with bash.
  WHY: Bash does not perform GitHub Actions expression substitution, causing the shell block and required CI tests to fail.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: lines 1735, 1742, 2015, 2020 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Dependency-check shell blocks embed raw `${{ github.repository }}` expressions that fail under direct shell execution.
  WHY: Bash cannot substitute GitHub Actions expressions; the reviewers report the same direct-execution failure mechanism as clarify.yml.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml: lines 501-502, 512-516 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A held dependency can override a Claude route with Codex and release the issue’s `ai:claude` claim.
  WHY: After the prerequisite merges and the issue is reprocessed, the Claude-routed follow-up can instead proceed through Codex; openai_gpt-6-luna rated this MAJOR while the other reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/claude_issue_route.py: lines 1259-1265 in _cmd_security_dependency() | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Incomplete or synthetic issue metadata can cause `_cmd_security_dependency()` to return held before determining whether the issue has a security dependency.
  WHY: The identity-validation error is caught as a held verdict, causing non-security issues with missing metadata to be skipped; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated this MAJOR while google_gemini-3_8-flash and minimax_minimax-m3 rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/claude_issue_route.py: lines 1127-1138 in queue_stale() | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A failed or missing prerequisite read can make `queue_stale()` silently skip a dependent queue item.
  WHY: The held verdict takes a `continue` path without reporting the stale item, so persistent read failures can leave it stuck without an alert.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 1686-1689, 1747-1754, 1802-1835 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Same-file follow-up chaining depends on findings/index iteration order, so a new finding can be created before an existing predecessor is registered, and the selected existing chain tail can depend on iteration order rather than issue creation order.
  WHY: A new follow-up may omit `Depends on:` or depend on an older issue, allowing same-file follow-ups to dispatch concurrently or out of order.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 15786-15790 and 15836-15890 in run_standalone_stall_recovery | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new dependency-release branch reads `_standalone_staged_support_cache_available` and `comments_json` before they are initialized for the current loop iteration.
  WHY: Under `set -euo pipefail`, an unset-variable error can terminate standalone stall recovery; openai_gpt-6-luna rated this MAJOR while minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 1802-1825 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: An existing finding without a valid positive issue number can default to issue number `0` and fall through to creation using `-` as the body-file path.
  WHY: The shell loop may attempt to create a corrupted follow-up issue using `-` as its title and body-file input.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml: lines 507-509 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A failed `ai:clarification` label write exits the step before it writes the expected `GITHUB_OUTPUT` values.
  WHY: Downstream steps receive empty outputs and issue processing can fail or take the wrong branch instead of remaining available for retry.
- scripts/claude_issue_route.py: lines 256-265 in fetch_security_dependency() | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `gh api` subprocess in `fetch_security_dependency()` has no timeout.
  WHY: A hung subprocess can block queue, watchdog, clarify, implement, or poller work until the job timeout.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 15865-15886 in run_standalone_stall_recovery() | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The ready-dependency branch can post `/reclarify` without checking whether the issue is still in the `ai:clarification` phase.
  WHY: An issue already in planning, awaiting approval, or implementing can be re-clarified and have its active pipeline disrupted.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 15858-15889 in run_standalone_stall_recovery | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The poller can re-clarify a ready Claude security follow-up while the Claude pickup also dispatches the queued item.
  WHY: The two release paths can create duplicate intake or implementation dispatches and race over the held `ai:clarification` label.
- scripts/claude_issue_route.py: lines 887-903 in queue_pending() | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A dependency lookup without `repository_url` can be treated as a repository mismatch and leave a dependent queue item held indefinitely.
  WHY: The held item has no release path through pickup even after the prerequisite is merged.
- scripts/claude_issue_route.py: lines 1141-1142 (queue_stale try/except pass) | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `queue_stale()` suppresses `ValueError` and `AttributeError` from dependency-branch parsing or rendering.
  WHY: Producer/consumer drift can be reported as a generic pickup-stalled condition instead of a binding mismatch.
- scripts/claude_issue_intake.sh: lines 241-253 (security-dependency read in intake) | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The queue payload can retain a `depends_on` snapshot that becomes stale before pickup processes it.
  WHY: A predecessor that is later deleted, transferred, or otherwise changed can leave the dependent queue item held indefinitely.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 1822-1838 (FOLLOWUP_URL capture, abort path) | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Concurrent audits can create duplicate follow-up issues for the same finding when their tracker-marker updates are not yet visible to one another.
  WHY: Both runs can observe the same finding as new and create issues, duplicating follow-ups.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 1821-1825 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `gh issue create` call is not retried, leaving a posted tracker comment and dated section without a corresponding issue after a transient failure; overlapping audits can also duplicate issue creation.
  WHY: The partial failure leaves inconsistent tracking, while concurrent runs can both create a follow-up for the same finding.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: lines 1733-1745 (Validate approval phase label step) | severity=high | confidence=[]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The step overwrites `${ISSUE_META_FILE}` with `DEPENDENCY_META`, replacing previously enriched metadata including Claude routing hints.
  WHY: The input is truncated during this finding before its runtime explanation or severity and confidence are provided.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: lines 1735, 2015 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: `implement.yml` repeats REST requests for issue metadata that an earlier step already fetched.
  WHY: The redundant requests consume GitHub API quota within the same workflow run.
- changelog.d/4934-chain-security-followups.md: lines 1-2 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment is reported to omit the required lead paragraph and audience-closing section.
  WHY: The fragment is reported as not following the repository’s changelog structure.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml: lines 411, 499-509 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The clarify routing step gains a GitHub write token and label-mutation capability.
  WHY: This expands the step’s capability from routing decisions to mutations; the reviewers describe the label write as intentional but as an added trust-boundary and side-effect concern.

  confidence=[1]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The chaining logic in security_audit.sh (Depends on: #N lines, LAST_FOLLOWUP_BY_FILE), the dependency check in claude_issue_route.py (security_dependency_number, security_dependency_verdict, _cmd_security_dependency), and the hold gate in clarify.yml (DEPENDENCY_VERDICT block) are all present in the PR diff. This requirement appears satisfied by the implementation.
- requirement: "Follow-ups on different files still dispatch together."
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh (file_key-based chaining via hashlib.sha256)
  confidence=[1]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The implementation uses per-file sha256 keys for LAST_FOLLOWUP_BY_FILE, so different files get different entries and do not chain. The test test_security_audit_chains_only_same_file_followups_and_recovers_predecessor verifies a fourth finding on a different file has no Depends on line. This requirement appears satisfied.
